# Statuses of the macros in libgcc/config.in, which libgcc's configure writes
# into auto-target.h. //runtimes/libgcc/tests:configure_inventory_* fails for a
# macro without a status, and checks each status against the headers that
# configure.ac.bzl renders.
#
# Columns: macro, status, and optionally the CPUs whose configure checks the
# macro, comma-separated. Without the third column, every CPU checks it. A
# gcc=<first>-<last> field limits the line to the GCC versions from <first> up
# to but not including <last>. Either bound may be left out, and a field may
# list several ranges, comma-separated.
#
# probe-modeled: a probe renders it in auto-target.h.
# policy-modeled: a fixed value renders it in auto-target.h.
# cflags-probe-modeled: a probe renders it in libgcc_configure_cflags.h, since
#   the configure script GCC ships passes it as a -D flag.
# not-needed: neither header has it, because nothing on a ported target reads
#   it, though GCC's auto-target.h may define it.
#
# A macro must be in its header for the CPUs that check it and in neither
# header for the others.
AS_HIDDEN_DIRECTIVE probe-modeled
HAVE_AS_AVX probe-modeled x86_64
HAVE_AS_CFI_SECTIONS probe-modeled
HAVE_AS_LSE probe-modeled aarch64 gcc=9.4.0-
HAVE_AS_VARIANT_PCS probe-modeled aarch64 gcc=14.0.0-
HAVE_CC_TLS cflags-probe-modeled
HAVE_FTW_H probe-modeled
HAVE_GETIPINFO policy-modeled
HAVE_INIT_PRIORITY probe-modeled
HAVE_INTTYPES_H probe-modeled
HAVE_MEMORY_H probe-modeled
HAVE_SOLARIS_CRTS not-needed gcc=-15.0.0
HAVE_STDINT_H probe-modeled
HAVE_STDLIB_H probe-modeled
HAVE_STRINGS_H probe-modeled
HAVE_STRING_H probe-modeled
HAVE_SYS_AUXV_H probe-modeled gcc=9.4.0-
HAVE_SYS_MMAN_H probe-modeled gcc=11.0.0-
HAVE_SYS_STAT_H probe-modeled
HAVE_SYS_TYPES_H probe-modeled
HAVE_UNISTD_H probe-modeled
HAVE___GETAUXVAL policy-modeled aarch64 gcc=14.0.0-
PACKAGE_BUGREPORT policy-modeled
PACKAGE_NAME policy-modeled
PACKAGE_STRING policy-modeled
PACKAGE_TARNAME policy-modeled
PACKAGE_URL policy-modeled
PACKAGE_VERSION policy-modeled
SIZEOF_DOUBLE probe-modeled
SIZEOF_LONG_DOUBLE probe-modeled
STDC_HEADERS probe-modeled
USE_EMUTLS cflags-probe-modeled
_DARWIN_USE_64_BIT_INODE not-needed gcc=9.4.0-
_FILE_OFFSET_BITS policy-modeled
_LARGE_FILES policy-modeled
